## A quick follow-up to the ALERT-screen glitch

Last release gave Squachy a running cameo on the detection screen -- fun, but a fresh detection (or an alert auto-dismissing after 10s and immediately re-triggering because the same thing's still in range) was re-rolling which side of the screen he's on every time, stacking an extra jump on top of the glitch-beat ones that were already there on purpose. He now just continues from wherever he already was.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: Squachy's ALERT-screen cameo no longer jumps sides on every new detection, only on its own intentional glitch-beat cadence
